d:
Two humanoid demonic entities with metallic, muscular builds and skin in shades of molten gold and obsidian black. The eyes are glowing electric yellow with narrow, menacing slits. Each possesses curved, blackened horns and a long, thick prehistoric tail with a spiked tip. The attire consists of traditional ornate gold armor plates and crimson loincloths.
BODY COLOR: molten gold and obsidian black
